explanations.3: This line checks if the visitor's IP address is NOT 127.0.0.1 (localhost on their own machine); the ! means 'not' and [NC] means ignore uppercase/lowercase differences.
explanations.5: This is a placeholder where you'd replace ADD_YOUR_IP_HERE with your actual IP address so you can access the site normally while others see the maintenance page.
explanations.6: This prevents the maintenance.php file itself from being redirected, so the actual maintenance page can load without causing an infinite loop.
explanations.7: If all the conditions above are true, any request gets sent to maintenance.php instead; [L] stops processing other rules, and [QSA] preserves any URL parameters.
